_note: Rank designs for gen_codex_rank_designs.py. Owner direction 2026-10-10: higher ranks must look clearly more distinctive than lower ones and communicate a higher tier, lore-accurately, while staying identifiable as the same character. '2' = Seasoned veteran, '3' = Elite; rank 3 is drawn from the installed rank-2 art, so each tier builds on the last. Each tier adds at least one new silhouette element and a stronger accent; face, body, base colours and weapon type stay. Weapons stay the same kind (attacks do not change). No names in prompts (prompt_scrub). Only units that rank up past their top level (no further promotion) are listed: troopers, militia and smugglers are promoted to sergeants, troopers and veterans instead, which carry the rank designs.

sw-unit-nr-sergeant.2: a seasoned sergeant: a grey armoured chest plate with a bright rank plaque of coloured squares on it, a pauldron on the near shoulder, and a comlink headset with a microphone boom
sw-unit-nr-sergeant.3: an elite senior sergeant: everything from the previous design plus a long olive field coat worn open over the armour, gold piping on the pauldron, and a command cap in place of the helmet

sw-unit-nr-commando.2: a seasoned commando: dark green and brown face paint and a camouflage-patterned helmet cover with leaves tucked into the straps
sw-unit-nr-commando.3: an elite forest commando: everything from the previous design plus a ragged camouflage poncho of forest colours draped over both shoulders that changes the silhouette, as worn by forest-moon raiders

sw-unit-nr-eweb-team.2: a seasoned heavy weapons crew: heat-blackened gauntlets, an armoured blast shield fixed to the repeating blaster with kill tallies painted on it
sw-unit-nr-eweb-team.3: an elite heavy weapons crew: everything from the previous design plus a large glowing blue power generator on a tripod beside the gun and full grey armour plates on the crew

sw-unit-nr-field-medic.2: a seasoned field medic: a white medical tabard over the vest with a blue medical emblem, and glowing blue healing-fluid canisters on the belt
sw-unit-nr-field-medic.3: an elite field surgeon: everything from the previous design plus a white armoured helmet with a blue stripe, a diagnostic scanner glowing on the forearm, and a small hovering spherical medical droid beside the shoulder

sw-unit-wk-warrior.2: a seasoned Wookiee warrior: a second crossed bandolier with metal ornaments and riveted metal bracers on both forearms
sw-unit-wk-warrior.3: an elite Wookiee war-chief: everything from the previous design plus woven-fibre and dark metal war armour on the chest and shoulders, as worn by tree-world warriors in their great battles, and a tall carved headdress

sw-unit-wk-lookout.2: a seasoned Wookiee scout: carved wooden beads braided into the fur and a leaf-green hunting sash
sw-unit-wk-lookout.3: an elite Wookiee tracker: everything from the previous design plus a hooded cloak of woven leaves over head and shoulders and a carved ornament on the crossbow-like weapon

sw-unit-nr-xwing.2: a seasoned starfighter: a bold second red stripe along each wing, a row of kill markings under the cockpit, and carbon scoring
sw-unit-nr-xwing.3: an elite squadron leader's starfighter: wide red bands on all four wing tips and the nose, a long row of kill markings, and a red-and-white astromech droid dome behind the cockpit

sw-unit-nr-awing.2: a seasoned interceptor: its red markings now in bold double stripes, with kill markings near the cockpit
sw-unit-nr-awing.3: an elite interceptor: a striking all-over red-and-white leader's paint scheme with gold trim on the engines and a long row of kill markings

sw-unit-nr-ywing.2: a seasoned bomber: bold yellow squadron stripes on the nose and engine cowlings and kill markings near the cockpit
sw-unit-nr-ywing.3: an elite bomber: wide yellow-and-black leader bands on nose and engines, refitted grey hull plating, and a long row of kill markings

sw-unit-sm-veteran.2: a seasoned smuggling veteran: a heavier long coat with a raised collar and a second holster on the thigh
sw-unit-sm-veteran.3: an elite smuggling captain: everything from the previous design plus a peaked captain's cap with a gold badge and a short dark shoulder cape

sw-unit-bi-commando.2: a seasoned resistance commando: a grey armoured chest plate with a pauldron on the near shoulder and a hand-painted squad stripe on the helmet
sw-unit-bi-commando.3: an elite resistance commando: full grey armour on chest, shoulders and shins, a helmet with a lowered visor and antenna, and a short dark field cape

sw-hero-han.2: the same hero, battle-hardened: a low-slung gun belt with extra power packs, red stripes running down the trouser legs, and a dark jacket worn open over the vest
sw-hero-han.3: the same hero as a seasoned general: a long dark coat with a raised collar over the vest, the red trouser stripes, and a general's rank plaque on the coat

sw-hero-leia.2: the same heroine in field gear: a hooded white field poncho over her outfit and a utility belt

sw-hero-chewbacca.2: the same Wookiee with a second crossed bandolier and riveted metal bracers on both forearms
sw-hero-chewbacca.3: the same Wookiee with everything from the previous design plus dark metal and woven-fibre war armour plates on the shoulders and chest

sw-hero-lando.2: the same hero with a longer, richer cape with a gold-patterned lining

sw-hero-luke.2: the same hero with a plain brown hooded robe worn open over his black outfit

sw-hero-xwing-luke.2: the same starfighter with a bold second red stripe on each wing and kill markings under the cockpit
sw-hero-xwing-luke.3: the same starfighter with wide red bands on all four wing tips and nose and a long row of kill markings

sw-hero-wedge.2: the same starfighter with a long row of kill markings and bold red stripes
sw-hero-wedge.3: the same starfighter in squadron-leader paint: wide red bands on all four wing tips and the nose and gold trim on the cockpit

sw-hero-mara.2: the same heroine with a short dark cloak over her flight suit and a utility belt with pouches

sw-hero-bel-iblis.2: the same general with a dark short cape over his long coat

sw-hero-khabarakh.2: the same warrior with bold pale clan markings painted on the grey skin of his face and arms
